import re


_URL_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"^(?:http|ftp)s?://"  # http://, https://, ftp://, ftps://
    r"(?:\S+@)?"  # optional userinfo
    r"(?:(?:[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?\.)+[A-Z]{2,}"  # domain name
    r"|localhost"
    r"|\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}"  # IPv4
    r")"
    r"(?::\d+)?"  # optional port
    r"(?:[/?#]\S*)?$"  # optional path, query, fragment
    ,
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def is_valid_URL(str):
    """Write a function to check if a url is valid or not using regex."""
    if not isinstance(str, type("")):
        return False
    return _URL_REGEX.match(str) is not None
